INDIA METEOROLOGICAL DEPARTMENT – REPLAY SAMPLE
*** Reconstructed for training/replay from publicly reported facts. NOT an official IMD product. ***
TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY BULLETIN
Bulletin No.: FANI-2019/14
Issued at: 0830 IST, 30 April 2019
Sub: Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm 'FANI' over west-central Bay of Bengal – Odisha coast

The Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm 'FANI' lay centred at 0830 hours IST of 30 April 2019 near latitude 13.6°N and longitude 85.3°E. Estimated central pressure 956 hPa. It is very likely to move north-northwestwards, intensify up to 210 km/h and cross the Odisha coast near Puri, Odisha during the afternoon of 03 May 2019 with maximum sustained wind speed of 170-180 km/h gusting to 200 km/h.

Forecast track and intensity:

02.05.19/2030 | 18.4/85.0 | 190-200 gusting to 220 | 937 | ESCS
03.05.19/0830 | 19.7/85.6 | 170-180 gusting to 200 | 944 | ESCS
03.05.19/2030 | 21.3/86.4 | 105-115 gusting to 135 | 975 | SCS

Storm surge: Storm surge of about 1.5 m above astronomical tide is likely to inundate low lying areas of Puri, Khurda, Ganjam and Jagatsinghpur districts at the time of landfall.
Sea condition: Phenomenal to very high. Fishermen are advised not to venture into the sea.
Next bulletin: in 3 hours.
